Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this game. The series now moves to Belfast for the second T20I, which will be played on 22nd July at 1600 Local (1500 GMT). So do join us for that. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Temba Bavuma, the South Africa skipper, says that he feels that 180 was a par score and that they were a few runs short after the first innings. Adds that bowling is their strength and he is super happy with the way they bowled. Credits every bowler for the way they bowled and defended the score.

Tabraiz Shamsi is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH, says that he just tries to execute the plans and do what the captain asks him to. Adds that he has a few more variations up his sleeve and the pitch made his job easier as he only had to bowl in the right areas.

Andy Balbirnie, the Ireland skipper, says that they did not bat very well in the Powerplay. Says that the target wasn't the big one but their batting was not up to the mark. Finishes by saying that they need to execute their plans better.

South Africa were brilliant with the ball. George Linde and Kagiso Rabada took one wicket each in the Powerplay while Lungi Ngidi took two to rock the Irish top order. After that, in the middle overs, it was their spin duo that ruled the game. Linde returned to take one more wicket and Tabraiz Shamsi spun a web around the batters with his 4 wickets in the middle overs. It was a team performance by them and they should be mighty pleased.

Paul Stirling hit a six on the first ball and that was the only thing that went Ireland's way. He fell on the very next ball and they lost Kevin O'Brien and George Dockrell soon after. Andy Balbirnie tried to replicate his form from the ODI series but fell in the last over of the Powerplay and they were way behind the curve. Harry Tector fought a lone battle in the middle overs but lacked support from the other batters. After he fell, the writing was clear on the wall and they fell short by 33 runs.

A wonderful bowling performance by South Africa to defend this score. This wasn't the biggest of the targets but their bowling never let the Irish get in front of the rate. So, South Africa win the first-ever T20I that they play against Ireland!
There it is! Shorter ball, around leg. Little leaves it. South Africa win by 33 runs!
Barry McCarthy comes down the track and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Back of a length, on off. Cut away to mid off for one.

Length ball, on the pads. Barry McCarthy gets hit on the pads and the ball goes towards third man for a leg bye.
Back of a length, on off. Little thinks of cutting it but leaves it alone.
Yorker, on middle. Barry McCarthy digs it to the leg side for one.
Yorker, on off. Drilled to cover for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Low full toss, on off. Barry McCarthy hits it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to mid off.
Shorter ball, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket. They sprint back for the second.
Full ball, on off. Heaved to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Slower short ball, outside off. Barry McCarthy pulls it to the square leg fence.
Short ball, on off. Little pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Little moves across to the off side to paddle it but gets no bat on it.
Full ball, on off. Drilled to long on for one.
Yorker, on off. Blocked out.
Short ball, on off. Little ducks under it.
Full ball, on off. Barry McCarthy hits the ball on the stumps at the other end. They take the single as it is deflected.
Fuller ball, on off. Barry McCarthy hammers it back to the bowler. Rabada drops a tough catch.
FOUR! Full ball, outside off. Barry McCarthy heaves it but gets the outside edge to the third man fence.
Yorker, on off. Blocked out.
Short of a good length ball on leg stump. Barry McCarthy hoicks it towards sqaure leg for one.
Slower ball and Barry McCarthy again misses the shot towards the on side. Gets hit on thigh pad. Deceived him completely did Lungi Ngidi .
Another slower one from Lungi Ngidi . Barry McCarthy misses the heave over the on side.
Short ball shoulder high. Josh Little mistimes the pull and the ball lands towards mid on.
Slower ball outside off. Josh Little misses the slog.
Short and wide outside off. Barry McCarthy smashes it to deep cover and Lizaad Williams has saved a certain boundary by diving to his right.
Lungi Ngidi is back on.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side. Barry McCarthy misses the whip.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed down to long on for one.

Slower bouncer and Josh Little gets hit high on the hand as he tries to pull it to the leg side. They take a single. There is a collision between Willams and McCarthy during the run and Williams runs to collect the ball.
Good length ball outside off. Josh Little misses the heave on the on side.
Shorter ball, on the pads. Pulled to deep square leg for one.
Full ball on stumps. Josh Little hits it straight back at the bowler. The ball hits Lizaad Williams on the leg and goes to the mid off fielder, and he misfields it. But they stay with the single.
WIDE! Short ball over head high. Josh Little leaves it.
Good length ball on middle. Defended towards mid-wicket.
Lizaad Williams comes back on. 2-0-17-0 so far.
FOUR! Tossed up, outside off. Barry McCarthy carves it over cover for a boundary.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to long on for one.
Josh Little is the last batter. A slip and a leg slip in place.

OUT! STUMPED! GOOGLY from Shamsi. Saw Harry Tector advancing down the track. He dragged the length back and Harry Tector misses the flick towards the on side. He is way down the pitch. Quinton de Kock whips off the bails and Tabraiz Shamsi is over the moon.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up ball on the stumps. Harry Tector drives it towards covers.
FOUR! Powerful! Tossed up ball on off. Harry Tector sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side yet again.
Tossed up on off. Barry McCarthy looks to drive it gets an inside edge and the ball rolls onto the off side. A single is taken.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side.
Tossed up on the stumps. Barry McCarthy blocks it to the off side and they steal a quick single.
Tossed up on off. Defended towards covers.
LEG BYE! Tector looks to sweep this tossed up ball, on the pads. It hits his pads and the ball rolls towards short fine leg.
Flatter on off. Pushed towards covers for a single.
TWO WIDES! Sprayed down the leg side. Tector and the keeper miss it.
Tossed up on middle. Turned towards the on side for a single by Barry McCarthy.
Flatter ball on the pads. Flicked to square leg for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Tector reverse scoops it towards third man. The fielder chases it and dives to save a couple of runs.
Down the leg side. Wide called.
Flatter ball, on off. Harry Tector gets hit on the pads as he looks to drive.
Barry McCarthy walks out to bat now.
OUT! OUT! CAUGHT! Tossed up outside off. Mark Adair looks to hit this over long off. Fails to middle the ball and the ball goes up in the air. George Linde takes a good running catch to his right.

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Mark Adair is the new batter.
OUT! BOWLED! Castled him! Tossed up on middle. Googly from Shamsi this time. Shane Getkate looks to whip it to the on side but misses. The ball crashes onto the stumps. And Tabraiz Shamsi is on fire!
Flatter ball on pads. Shane Getkate works this one towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter ball on stumps. Punched off the back foot for one towards point.
FOUR! Brave shot! Tossed up ball on leg stump. Harry Tector reverse sweeps it towards third man for a boundary.
Tossed up on leg stump. Turned towards long on for one.
Shane Getkate is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Cleaned him up! Lorcan Tucker gives himself too much room this time and fails to get a bat on it. The ball crashes onto the stumps. It was a flatter delivery pitched on the middle stump and stayed a touch low. And Ireland are now 6 down and staring down the barrel.
Tossed up on the pads. Flicked to short fine leg for one.
George Linde is back on. 2-0-12-1 so far.
Tossed up, on off. Tucker sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller ball, on middle. Tector drills it to long on for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Tector goes for the reverse sweep but gets hit on the hands.
Tector comes down the track and chips it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter ball, on middle. Tector gets hit on the pads as he looks to flick.
Full ball, on the pads. Clipped to deep square leg for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Tector cuts it well and a slight fumble at point allows the single. 111 needed in the last 11 overs.
Length ball, on the pads. Tucker clips it to deep square leg for one. South Africa won't mind these singles one bit.
Slower full toss, on the pads. Tucked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Top shot! Back of a length ball, outside off Tector guides it past point for a boundary.
Fuller ball, on off. Tucker gets the inside edge past the stumps for one.
Lizaad Williams is back on after getting for 9 in his first over.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to long on to get off the mark.
Lorcan Tucker walks out to bat.

OUT! Cleaned him up! And Tabraiz Shamsi gets the wicket of Simi Singh. Simi Singh tries to sweep the overpitched ball and almost yorks himself in the process. The ball crashes onto the stumps. Tabraiz Shamsi is delighted to see the back of Simi Singh
Short ball on off. Harry Tector punches it to long off for one.
Flighted ball on leg. Simi Singh sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Full ball, on off. Harry Tector reverse sweeps this to short third man for one.
Tossed up on middle. Harry Tector looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. There is an appeal but the ball was clearly going down the leg side.
Tabraiz Shamsi comes in the attack.
Length ball on middle stump. Simi Singh defends it back at the bowler.
Full ball on off. Driven towards long off for one.
Bouncer from Rabada. Simi Singh looks to pull it but gets high on the handle and the ball rolls towards the right of the keeper. They sneak in a single.
Good length ball on off, punched towards covers for one.
Good length ball on middle. Simi Singh gets a leading edge while playing the flick but the ball lands safely before the mid off fielder.
Good length ball, on the stumps. Harry Tector tucks it to mid on for a single.
Kagiso Rabada (1-0-11-1) comes back on.
Singh comes down the track looking to cut it away but gets no bat on it. The Powerplay is done and Ireland are 38 for 4!
Back of a length, on off. Blocked out.
Tector comes down the track and taps it to covers for one.
Length ball, on off. Tector works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Off the mark. Length ball, outside off. Pushed to third man for one.
Simi Singh is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Quinton de Kock makes amends and sends back the Irish skipper! Slower length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to carve it over the off side but gets the outside edge. Quinton de Kock leaps to his right and does the rest. Ireland are in big trouble now and they still need 132 runs in 89 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, outside off. Drilled to point for one.

DROPPED! Lizaad Williams was up in celebration! Full ball, outside off. Harry Tector shuffles across and scoops it straight towards square leg. Quinton de Kock runs across, he dives and takes it but his elbow hits the ground and the ball pops out. A single is taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Chopped to covers for one.
FOUR! Andy Balbirnie looks in great touch! Full and wide now. Andy Balbirnie clears his front leg and carves it to the point fence. The ball bounces a few inches inside the rope before going over.
Back of a length, outside off. Punched past point for one.
Full ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it well but the man at cover dives and stops three runs for his team. Janneman Malan was the fielder.
Lizaad Williams is on now.
Good length ball on off. Harry Tector defends it back at the bowler.
Good length ball on off. Turned towards mid on for one by Andy Balbirnie .
Short of a good length ball outside off. Punched towards point for a single by Tector.
Good length ball, around off. Defended towards the on side.
Good length ball, on off. Harry Tector pokes at it and edges to wide second slip on the bounce though.
Harry Tector walks out to bat. A slip is in place for him.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! George Dockrell looks to make some room on the leg side. Pokes at a ball pitched on a good length, around the off stump. Quinton de Kock takes it with ease and Lungi Ngidi gets a wicket on the first ball. What a start this is for him!
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Lungi Ngidi comes in the attack.
Tossed up on leg. George Dockrell gets inside the line and drives it to long off for a run.

Flatter on stumps. Pushed to covers yet again.
Flatter on off. Pushed to covers.

FOUR! Great shot! Tossed up on off. Gives himself some room and hits it over covers for a boundary does Andy Balbirnie.
Yorker, on the pads. Clipped to the leg side for one.
Full toss, on the body. Pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! One bounce four! Shorter ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie pulls it to the square leg fence.
FOUR! Misfield! Fuller ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it to the left of mid off. Temba Bavuma gets across but misfields and the ball runs to the fence.
Just a single as this is eased down to long on.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A golden duck for Kevin O'Brien and what a start this is for South Africa! Fuller ball, on off. The ball just holds in the pitch for a second so Kevin O'Brien ends up chipping it back to the bowler. Kagiso Rabada accepts the gift and sends back Ireland's other opener.
Who will come out next? George Dockrell is the new man in.
Sprays one down the leg side. Wide called.
Kagiso Rabada to start from the other end.
Loopy ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie goes for the drive but gets the outside edge towards short third man.
Loopy ball on off. Pushed to covers now.
Shorter ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie misses his cut.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
The skipper, Andy Balbirnie, walks out to bat.
OUT! BOWLED! And gone! Linde gets his man now! Fuller ball, on leg. Paul Stirling moves across the line to sweep it but misses. The ball goes on to hit the leg pole and he is gone!
SIX! All the way! What a way to start the chase! Loopy ball, on off. Paul Stirling sweeps it all the way over the mid-wicket fence.
